Subject: Vendor setup + payment terms question

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We're starting Solonix's vendor setup for Redwood and want to confirm the preferred PO and billing cadence so we can align our invoicing. A few specifics:
- Our standard is Net 45. Is that acceptable for Redwood?
- We would like to know if accelerated settlement / early-pay is available (we can offer a 1% discount for Net 10, or 0.5% for Net 15).
- Any required onboarding docs on your side (W-9, tax forms, vendor onboarding questionnaire)?

I'll attach our vendor profile and a sample invoice for reference (attached: Sample_Invoice_030527.pdf). If there's an AP portal we should register in, please share the link.

Hi Ben —

Thanks — welcome, and glad the call was useful. Short answers up front: we can onboard Solonix; Net 45 is within our standard acceptance window for strategic partners, and we do run an accelerated remit program for vendor discounts. A few actions to get you live:

1) Please complete and return our Vendor Onboarding Form (see link below) and attach a completed W-9.
2) Send a sample invoice with your preferred PO field populated (your internal PO / our PO mapping).
3) If you want early-pay pricing, confirm the discount tiers you propose and whether you need Net 10 vs Net 15. We typically approve no more than 1% for Net 10 on a case-by-case basis for committed volume.

I'll outline the options:
- Standard: Net 30 (default across most vendors) — faster from our bookkeeping side but not required if Net 45 is a contractual need.
- Flex for strategic vendors: Net 45 with optional accelerated remit — enroll in our e-invoice + early-pay program (requires registration in vendor portal + e-invoice delivery) => typical incentive 0.5%–1.0% depending on volume and e-invoice compliance.

Next steps: I'm attaching the onboarding checklist here and looping in Kimberly from AP to confirm portal registration details. If you want, we can do a short call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Karthik —

Thanks for the clarity. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Solonix prefers Net 45 because our revenue recognition and cash flow calendar is built around it. We can confirm Net 45 if Redwood can commit to payment windows consistently.
- We are happy to enroll in your e-invoice program. The 1% for Net 10 would be attractive but logistically difficult on our side; we can do 0.8% for Net 10 or 0.6% for Net 15. Would Redwood consider a 0.6% discount for Net 15 with electronic invoicing?
- Also: do you require Redwood's PO number on our invoices, or can we use Solonix's Sales PO and map it to your PO in the portal? Our ERP prefers to push our own PO field.

Attached: completed VendorOnboardingForm_Solonix.xlsx and the W-9. Please confirm receipt.

Ben

Hi Ben —

Thanks for sending the completed forms — received and validated. A few confirmations from Redwood AP:

1) Onboarding: Your vendor profile is created in our portal (Solonix ID: VND-7923). Please use the portal link below to complete bank details and enroll for e-invoicing: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-portal/solonix/activate

2) PO handling: We require Redwood PO on our end to trigger payment workflows. Your Solonix PO can be captured in your invoice as a referenced customer PO field; our portal maps that to our internal PO field during ingestion. So please include both (your PO in the "Customer PO" field and our PO when provided).

3) Terms & early-pay: Given Solonix's strategic commitment and the completed onboarding, Redwood will accept Net 45 as the base term. For early settlement: we can extend a 0.6% accelerated remit discount for Net 15 provided Solonix enrolls in e-invoice delivery and agrees to submit invoices via the portal within 5 business days of service completion. The discount will be processed automatically when payment is made within the Net 15 window.

4) Next actions:
- Ben: confirm you accept Net 45 with the optional 0.6% Net 15 early-pay program.
- Solonix AP (Leah): register in the vendor portal and attach bank details so we can enable ACH.

If you confirm, we'll push the enrollment to Finance and issue the first Redwood PO for the kickoff engagement.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
AP Manager, Redwood Inference
